description: Mobile users regularly face call drops, weak data speeds, and complete signal loss in rural areas, indoor basements, tunnels, and hilly terrain.so genuine dead zones stay hidden for this problem a  budget friendly IoT device is created and the source code for the device and a prototype level dashboard lies here.self-contained, budget-friendly hardware (IoT tracker) detector that samples live cellular signal strength (RSSI) across available network bands using a dedicated cellular modem paired with a GPS receiver for precise geographic tagging.
